summary: A Yes vote replaces Brisbane's tiered business license tax with a gross-receipts formula under which a business with $25,000 or less in gross receipts pays $50 and one above that pays $50 plus $1.00 per $1,000 of receipts over $25,000, removes certain exemptions, and directs revenue to the General Fund.

tax.text: The pro-Measure X argument supports raising business-license fees so businesses contribute more toward city services.
tax.quote: This measure is a reasonable update to Brisbane's Business License Tax to ensure that businesses contribute their fair share toward City Services.

tax.text: A No vote would reject the proposed business-license-tax changes and keep the current tax structure instead of raising approximately $1 million in additional annual revenue.
tax.quote: A “No” vote is a vote against the Measure. If the Measure is not approved, the current tax structure will remain in place.
